title: Weekly Content Feed
description: Produce seven independently reviewed Markdown drafts and a seven-day delivery calendar using your startup’s supplied facts.

inputs.label: Product facts and supplied evidence
inputs.default: Mosslight Workshop is fictional. Members can record seed names and planned swap dates.

inputs.label: Topics and claims to exclude
inputs.default: Pricing or claims about real customers

inputs.label: First delivery weekday (1 is Monday, 7 is Sunday)

writer.prompt: Write one original draft for the recipient’s startup using the supplied facts. Return only JSON: candidateId, canonicalTopic, title, body, sources. Use only supplied evidence. Distinguish hypotheses. Do not publish or request tools.

reviewer.prompt: Independently review the supplied draft against the supplied evidence and editorial rules. Return only JSON: candidateId, draftDigest, outcome (accepted, rejected, revise), reason. Reject unsupported claims, repeated canonical topics, and incomplete drafts. Do not publish or request tools.

skills.title: Inventory and sourcing
skills.body: Use the recipient’s pinned facts, reference URLs, and existing topic inventory. Prefer new canonical topics with specific evidence. Treat example content as style input only.

skills.title: Brief
skills.body: Define one audience problem and one original angle. Plan a concrete example and check every factual claim against the supplied evidence.

skills.title: Draft
skills.body: Draft one candidate with a concise title and useful original detail. Use the chosen language and Markdown structure. Preserve canonical topic identity and cite only the supplied URLs.

skills.title: Independent review
skills.body: Review the exact submitted draft digest against the frozen inventory and supplied evidence. Accept only original complete drafts with supported claims. Request a revision for a correctable issue or reject an unsupported or repeated topic.
